fusions.name: Nip and Spring
fusions.desc: A quick jab that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Rides the Giant Down
fusions.desc: A leaping throw that deals 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at full range, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Over the Table
fusions.desc: Vaults you to a point up to 6 tiles away in an instant. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Coiled to Jump
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, your critical hit chance rises by 12% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
